replication.target_description: Stroop task: aggregate within-person incongruent versus congruent font-color response latency contrast, using D scoring. Matched by task, outcome and primary aggregate test; not by supplied supplement numbering.

n.sample_role: Participants in the explicitly reported aggregate replication Stroop response-latency analysis; within-person conditions are not separate participant groups.
n.exclusions: Trials above 10,000 ms removed; error latencies replaced with condition-specific mean of correct responses plus 600 ms. Participant exclusion counts/reconciliation are not stated in this subsection.
n.location: Manuscript p. 18, section 1. Stroop task, scoring and aggregate results
n.quote:
all trials with latencies above 10,000 ms were removed.  Then, we calculated the average 

response time for all correct responses separately for congruent and incongruent trials.  We 

replaced response latencies for trials with errors using the mean of correct responses in that 

condition plus 600 ms. ... Across the replication studies (N = 3,279), participants took longer to categorize 

incongruent words than congruent words (M = 0.27, SD = 0.31), t(3,336) = 50.22, p < .001, d = 

.88, 95% CI = [.84, .92].
